privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.body:
Newspapers Land is a directory of newspapers. It shows you their headlines and lets you read them.

## What the app collects

Nothing that identifies you. There is no account, no sign-in and no profile. The papers you follow, the stories you have read and every setting live on your phone and are never sent anywhere.

## What leaves the phone

Requests to the newspapers themselves, when you open a story, and to our own server for the directory of papers. Those carry no identifier of yours beyond what any browser sends.

## Notifications

If you switch alerts on, the phone registers with Google for messaging. We send to a country, never to a person: we cannot tell one reader from another.

## Getting in touch

Write to support@newspapersland.com and say what you would like removed.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body:
## What this app is

Newspapers Land lists newspapers and shows their public feeds. The journalism belongs to the papers that wrote it.

## What you may do

Read, share a link, and follow whichever papers you like.

## What we do not promise

That every feed works, that every paper is listed, or that a story is still there when you tap it. Newspapers change their sites without telling us.

takedown.title: Copyright and takedowns
takedown.body:
## If you are a publisher

The app shows your headline, the first lines of your feed and a link to your page. If you would rather it did not, write to us and it will stop.

## How to ask

Email support@newspapersland.com with the name of the paper and the address of the feed. We remove it, usually the same day, and we do not ask why.
